review.summary: Actual standard views and cached decoded-stage views both show large torn/complex relief across the rear face of the divider. The reference requires a simple solid privacy panel with two mounting brackets. Cache exports verified zero additional AI sampling and show this defect was already present before postprocessing.

issues.problem: Large invented cavities and protruding fragments replace the clean rear panel. Preserve the outline, rounded corners and two mounting brackets while producing a coherent solid panel.

review.summary: Actual multiview sheet and hero show the large torn rear relief removed in m2, but a conspicuous central handle-like strip remains on the rear privacy panel. The intended asset is a plain divider supported by two edge brackets, not an additional handled panel.

issues.problem: Remove the invented central handle/strip and retain a clean rear face with the required two edge mounting brackets.

review.summary: Actual final/source sheet and full hero retain clean front/rear panel surfaces, rounded corners, dark edging and both metallic mounting brackets. Fresh FBX/GLB verification passes at 14,825 triangles; no major regression or extra rear fixture appears.

issues.problem: Minor neutral-shading edge undulations and softened screw detail remain subtle in the final material; the overall divider construction is preserved.

review.summary: Actual multiview sheet and full hero show consistent pale panel surfaces, a dark perimeter edge and metallic mounting brackets on both faces. No return of the earlier torn rear structure or invented handle.

issues.problem: A faint patterned texture and slightly heavier brackets differ from the reference but preserve the intended clean divider appearance.

review.summary: Actual multiview sheet and full hero show a clean solid privacy panel with rounded outer corners and exactly two edge mounting brackets. The torn rear relief and central handle from earlier shapes are absent.

issues.problem: Bracket plates and fastener relief are slightly thicker than the reference, while the mounting relationship and panel silhouette remain coherent.
